_documentation.purpose: Long-running feedback experiment that tries to move one vortex 5 nm in +y using a laser held ahead of it. Thermal hysteresis switches illumination off and back on; checkpoints permit restart.
_documentation.relies_on: configs/simulations/nbn_optical_vortex_unpinned.json supplies the NbN film, mesh, two-temperature and TDGL solvers. This runner sets field, zero current, initial vortex, laser and optional pinning.

fields.simulation_config: Base film, material and solver configuration.
fields.applied_field_T: Uniform perpendicular magnetic field in tesla.
fields.initial_vortex: Seeded single-vortex location and charge in fractional film coordinates.
fields.seed_position_m: Physical seed used to locate the prepared vortex.
fields.target.displacement_m: Desired displacement from the dark-prepared vortex center, [dx,dy] in metres.
fields.target.tolerance_nm: Distance from the target in nanometres that counts as arrival.
fields.laser.absorbed_power_W: Film-absorbed laser power while illumination is on; zero when switched off.
fields.laser.spot_sigma_m: Gaussian heating spot width in metres.
fields.laser.offset_m: Beam-center position relative to the last accepted vortex center while following it.
fields.laser.max_speed_m_s: Maximum beam translation speed in metres per second.
fields.laser.update_every_steps: Number of accepted steps between beam target updates.
fields.pinning.enabled: Enable or disable listed Gaussian pinning sites.
fields.pinning.sites: Defect position, width and dimensionless GL-coefficient suppression; these are not calibrated force values.
fields.thermal_control.switch_off_K: Turn laser off when the previous accepted peak electron temperature reaches this value.
fields.thermal_control.restart_below_K: Restart only after peak electron temperature cools below this lower value.
fields.thermal_control.hard_stop_K: Terminate if a physical step reaches this safety limit, below Tc.
fields.thermal_control.minimum_dwell_steps: Minimum accepted steps before reversing an on/off decision, to avoid rapid switching.
fields.timing.dark_steps: Laser-off preparation steps before the transport experiment.
fields.timing.max_steps: Maximum physical transport steps (dt comes from the base simulation).
fields.timing.checkpoint_every: Steps between atomic state checkpoints and progress messages.
fields.timing.stall_consecutive_windows: Number of consecutive windows with insufficient progress before stop.
fields.timing.minimum_progress_per_window_nm: Smallest targetward progress considered useful in one window.
fields.timing.max_wall_hours: Upper wall-clock hours for one invocation; resume can continue later.
fields.output_directory: Base output folder; numbered siblings preserve previous runs.
